statement.en: Every cited key exists in the bibliography.

statement.en: Every bibliography entry is cited.
statement.zh: 参考文献库中的每个条目都被引用。

why.en: An uncited entry is dead weight, or a citation was lost during editing.
why.zh: 未被引用的条目要么多余，要么是修改中丢失了引用。

statement.en: No duplicate keys in the bibliography.
statement.zh: 参考文献库中没有重复的键。

why.en: BibTeX keeps one entry silently and the other is lost.
why.zh: BibTeX会悄悄保留一条，另一条丢失。

statement.en: Bibliography entries are complete: required fields present, full author lists; optional: given names as initials.
statement.zh: 参考文献条目完整：必备字段齐全、作者列表完整；可选：名用首字母。

why.en: Incomplete entries cannot be verified and print inconsistently. Required fields per entry type are set in document.json.
why.zh: 条目不完整就无法核对，排版也不一致。各条目类型的必备字段在document.json中设置。

statement.en: Bibliography entries carry no DOI or URL (venue style).
statement.zh: 参考文献条目不含DOI与URL（视期刊格式）。

why.en: Some venues print references without DOI or URL.
why.zh: 部分期刊的参考文献不印DOI与URL。

statement.en: The text uses the glossary term, not the old name or alias (glossary field avoid_en).
statement.zh: 全文使用术语表中的主术语，不用旧名与别名（术语表字段avoid_en）。

why.en: One concept, one name: the reader should never wonder whether two names mean two things.
why.zh: 一个概念一个名称：读者不应疑惑两个名称是否指两件事。

statement.en: The abstract states, in order: the state of the field, the gap, the motivation, the method, the results.
statement.zh: 摘要按顺序写：研究现状、不足、动机、方法、结果。

why.en: A reader who stops after the abstract should still know why the work exists and what it found.
why.zh: 只读摘要的读者也应知道这项工作为什么存在、发现了什么。

statement.en: The abstract carries at most a few numbers (document.json: E6.max_numbers).
statement.zh: 摘要只写少数几个数字（document.json：E6.max_numbers）。

why.en: Three numbers are remembered; ten are not.
why.zh: 三个数字能记住，十个记不住。

statement.en: The conclusion echoes the abstract and adds no new claim.
statement.zh: 结论回扣摘要，不引入新的主张。

why.en: The paper should end where it said it would go.
why.zh: 论文应在摘要所说的地方结束。

statement.en: A comparative or superiority claim is traced to a table, a figure or a citation (the checker flags; the author decides).
statement.zh: 比较性或优势性表述须有依据：表、图或引用（自动标出，作者判断）。

why.en: Unsupported superlatives are the first thing a reviewer attacks.
why.zh: 没有依据的最高级表述最先被审稿人质疑。

rules.note: partly automatic: the checker flags, the author decides

statement.en: In the introduction the problem and the motivation each have their own paragraph, both before the method.
statement.zh: 引言中“问题”与“动机”各成一段，均在“方法”段之前。

why.en: The reader should accept the problem before meeting the solution.
why.zh: 读者应先接受问题，再见到方法。

statement.en: No sentence is printed twice.
statement.zh: 同一句话不出现两次。

why.en: A repeated sentence usually means a paragraph was copied and not rewritten.
why.zh: 重复句通常说明段落被复制而没有改写。

statement.en: The discussion answers the research question and does not list limitations item by item.
statement.zh: 讨论回答研究问题，不逐条罗列局限。

why.en: An itemized limitation list invites the reviewer to take each item as a reason to reject.
why.zh: 逐条罗列局限会让审稿人把每一条都当作拒稿理由。

statement.en: One main action per sentence: at most two finite clauses (a main clause plus one complete supporting clause), no clause nested in a subordinate clause, no “which” that refers to a whole clause. Flagged sentences are rewritten or kept with a written reason.
statement.zh: 一句一个主要动作：至多两个限定小句（主句加一个完整从句），不嵌套从句，不用指代整句的which；标出的句子改写，或写明理由后保留。

why.en: A sentence that carries two actions makes the reader decide which one matters.
why.zh: 一句话承担两个动作，读者要自己判断哪个重要。

rules.note: partly automatic: the checker flags, the author decides

statement.en: Complete clauses: no participle phrase set off by a comma (“…, thereby joining …”) and no verbless adjective clause (“…, possible because …”).
statement.zh: 完整从句：不用逗号后的分词短语（“…, thereby joining …”）或无动词的形容词从句（“…, possible because …”）。

why.en: A dangling participle hides who acts and what follows from what.
why.zh: 悬垂的分词短语看不出谁是施事、什么由什么推出。

statement.en: Qualifiers first: no prepositional qualifier appended after the last comma of a sentence.
statement.zh: 限定成分在前：不在句末逗号后追加介词短语。

why.en: Put the qualification before the claim, so the claim is read with it.
why.zh: 把限定放在主张之前，主张就带着限定被读到。

statement.en: A real condition or time clause (if, unless, only when, when, before, after, until, once) comes before the action.
statement.zh: 真实的条件与时间从句（if、unless、only when、when、before、after、until、once）放在动作之前。

why.en: The reader should know under which condition a statement holds before reading the statement.
why.zh: 读者应先知道陈述成立的条件，再读陈述。

statement.en: Active voice: body sentences have no passive (captions excepted); an adjectival use is an exception with a written reason.
statement.zh: 主动语态：正文句不用被动（图注除外）；形容词用法逐句写明理由后作为例外。

why.en: The item itself acts; the reader sees what does what.
why.zh: 让事物本身作主语；读者看得出谁对谁做了什么。

statement.en: “We” only where the authors are the actor (proposing the method, stating contributions); otherwise the item is the subject.
statement.zh: 少用“we”：作者是施事时（提出方法、贡献）才用，其余以事物作主语。

why.en: Most sentences are about the method or the data, not about the authors.
why.zh: 多数句子讲方法或数据，不是讲作者。

statement.en: No filler: no sentence without information (signposts, restatements, display or processing disclaimers). Restatement needs a reading.
statement.zh: 不写空话：无信息的路标句、重述句、显示或处理说明（重述靠通读）。

why.en: Every sentence should change what the reader knows.
why.zh: 每句话都应改变读者所知。

rules.note: partly automatic: the checker flags, the author decides

statement.en: No self-criticism outside the discussion or limitation sections (project setting limitation_sections).
statement.zh: 讨论与局限章节以外不写自我限定或自我批评（项目设置limitation_sections）。

why.en: Strengths first; limitations belong where the paper weighs them.
why.zh: 先写优势；局限属于论文权衡它们的地方。

statement.en: No sentence implies that an experiment that could have been run is missing.
statement.zh: 不写暗示缺少本可做的实验的句子。

why.en: “Not yet evaluated” invites the reviewer to ask for it.
why.zh: “尚未评估”会邀请审稿人去要求它。

statement.en: Consequence connectives (therefore, thus, so, thereby) mark only a real consequence: at most one per sentence, no repeat in a paragraph, not in two consecutive sentences, not before “we propose”. The premise is checked by hand.
statement.zh: 结果连接词（therefore、thus、so、thereby）只标真实的结果：每句至多一个、同段不重复、不连续两句、不用于“we propose”之前；前提逐句人工核对。

why.en: A connective that is not a consequence is a false promise of logic.
why.zh: 不表示结果的连接词是对逻辑的虚假承诺。

rules.note: partly automatic: the checker flags, the author decides

statement.en: The head noun of every subject and object comes from the glossary or from the closed noun lists; otherwise use a pronoun.
statement.zh: 主语、宾语的中心名词取自术语表或闭合名词清单，否则用代词。

why.en: A fixed set of head nouns keeps one thing under one name across the paper.
why.zh: 固定的中心名词集合让同一事物在全文保持同一名称。

statement.en: One thing keeps one head noun: concept rules list phrases that name a glossary concept with another noun.
statement.zh: 同一事物同一中心名词：概念规则列出用别的名词指称术语表概念的短语。

why.en: Two nouns for one thing make the reader suspect two things.
why.zh: 同一事物两个名词，读者会怀疑是两件事。

statement.en: Plain words and direct verbs; no decoration with elevated words; necessary terms stay.
statement.zh: 用常见词和直接动词，不用高级词装饰；必要术语保留。

why.en: Plain words are read faster and mistranslated less.
why.zh: 常见词读得快，也更不易被误译。

statement.en: While, whereas, instead, unlike mark a real parallel, contrast or replacement, never a cause.
statement.zh: while、whereas、instead、unlike只用于真实的并行、对照或替代关系，不代替因果。

why.en: A contrast word on a cause misleads the logic.
why.zh: 把对照词用在因果上会误导逻辑。

statement.zh: 摘要字数在期刊限制内（document.json：J1.min、J1.max）。

why.en: Venue limit.

why.en: Venue style.
why.zh: 期刊格式。

statement.en: Figures and tables are numbered in the order of their first citation (checked on the source).
statement.zh: 图、表各自按首次引用的顺序编号（按源文件核查）。

why.en: The reader meets Fig. 3 after Fig. 2.
why.zh: 读者先遇到图2，再遇到图3。

statement.en: A text citation comes before the figure or table it cites, and every figure and table is cited.
statement.zh: 正文引用先于对应的图表出现，且每个图表都被引用。

why.en: A float that appears before it is cited asks the reader a question the text has not yet raised.
why.zh: 先于引用出现的图表向读者提出了正文还没提出的问题。

statement.en: Every \ref, \eqref, \autoref and \cref points to an existing \label.
statement.zh: 每个\ref、\eqref、\autoref、\cref都指向存在的\label。

why.en: An unknown label prints as ?? in the PDF.
why.zh: 未知标签在PDF中显示为??。

statement.en: Captions are short: only what is needed to read the figure; the mechanism belongs in the text.
statement.zh: 图注、表题简短：只写看图所需，机制放正文。

why.en: Readers skim captions.
why.zh: 读者会浏览图注。

statement.en: Text inside figures is readable at the final column width (about 8 pt or more in print).
statement.zh: 图内文字在最终栏宽下可读（印刷字号约8 pt以上）。

why.en: Unreadable figure text is lost information.
why.zh: 读不清的图内文字等于丢失信息。

statement.en: Every rule is in the register exactly once and sits in the rule tree.
statement.zh: 每条规则都在规则登记中且只出现一次，并位于规则树中。

why.en: A rule outside the tree is never run in the right order.
why.zh: 不在树中的规则不会按正确顺序运行。

statement.en: Every testable rule flags its “flag” sentences and passes its “pass” sentences.
statement.zh: 每条可测试的规则都标出它的“flag”测试句、放过它的“pass”测试句。

why.en: A rule edit that breaks its own tests is caught before it touches the paper.
why.zh: 改坏了测试的规则改动在碰到论文之前就会被发现。

statement.en: Write “vs.” (not “v.s.”).
statement.zh: 写“vs.”，不写“v.s.”。

why.en: One spelling of the abbreviation across the paper.
why.zh: 全文同一种缩写写法。

statement.en: Do not open a sentence with “Besides,” — use “In addition,” or restructure.
statement.zh: 不以“Besides,”开头——用“In addition,”或重组句子。

why.en: “Besides” reads as an afterthought; the next idea should follow from the one before.
why.zh: “Besides”像事后补充；下一个观点应由前一个观点引出。
